parameter real dense_4_W_15[0:N_NEURONS-1] = {1.232311129570007324e-02,-1.046313941478729248e-01,-5.819495022296905518e-02,1.878224611282348633e-01,2.863096892833709717e-01,1.411136388778686523e-01,-9.028948098421096802e-02,-1.608706265687942505e-01,-1.799171417951583862e-01,-2.117378562688827515e-01,-1.543561369180679321e-01,3.569662570953369141e-01,-3.739641010761260986e-01,1.645134091377258301e-01,1.575728207826614380e-01,5.336202308535575867e-02,-1.553387790918350220e-01,-2.819712758064270020e-01,3.001883029937744141e-01,2.087640808895230293e-03}; // <-- dense_4_W.txt의 16행
parameter real dense_4_W_16[0:N_NEURONS-1] = {-2.266770601272583008e-01,-3.026376962661743164e-01,-1.351228803396224976e-01,1.305398195981979370e-01,3.547708988189697266e-01,2.379441708326339722e-01,2.514733374118804932e-01,3.322712182998657227e-01,-3.438116908073425293e-01,-1.170218288898468018e-01,3.435859978199005127e-01,-2.551552653312683105e-01,-3.603474497795104980e-01,7.481038570404052734e-03,3.739221692085266113e-01,1.433502882719039917e-01,-5.405545234680175781e-03,1.854449510574340820e-03,4.114836826920509338e-02,2.992949485778808594e-01}; // <-- dense_4_W.txt의 17행
parameter real dense_4_W_17[0:N_NEURONS-1] = {-1.017458057403564453e+01,3.342710137367248535e-01,-1.348127424716949463e-01,-2.192256152629852295e-01,-9.150505810976028442e-02,-2.390150278806686401e-01,-8.829093724489212036e-02,8.615807890892028809e-01,-6.094144284725189209e-02,4.569127038121223450e-02,2.163876295089721680e-01,1.473965406417846680e+00,-7.101003546267747879e-03,2.597946226596832275e-01,7.448449730873107910e-01,-2.450980097055435181e-01,-3.431828618049621582e-01,3.028360605239868164e-01,4.253019988536834717e-01,1.234254911541938782e-01}; // <-- dense_4_W.txt의 18행
parameter real dense_4_W_18[0:N_NEURONS-1] = {-2.613193392753601074e-01,2.301081418991088867e-01,7.134010642766952515e-02,-1.756585240364074707e+00,3.482447862625122070e-01,3.924744725227355957e-01,3.554197251796722412e-01,4.676785469055175781e-01,-4.054103493690490723e-01,-1.527884323149919510e-02,-2.269452437758445740e-02,8.799921870231628418e-01,2.227309197187423706e-01,1.720687374472618103e-02,5.523182451725006104e-02,-3.035785257816314697e-02,6.361423432826995850e-02,-2.462773174047470093e-01,4.006731510162353516e-01,-1.014111563563346863e-02}; // <-- dense_4_W.txt의 19행
parameter real dense_4_W_19[0:N_NEURONS-1] = {4.430395364761352539e-01,4.293065965175628662e-01,-2.439673691987991333e-01,-6.305865198373794556e-02,1.956935524940490723e-01,-1.123307704925537109e+00,4.353359043598175049e-01,2.511690743267536163e-02,2.655182182788848877e-01,-3.302154242992401123e-01,3.206792473793029785e-01,-5.970129966735839844e-01,1.675923466682434082e-01,-1.837960779666900635e-01,-3.946641683578491211e-01,1.213524956256151199e-02,-3.848954141139984131e-01,-1.426406949758529663e-01,-1.543115377426147461e-01,3.781818449497222900e-01}; // <-- dense_4_W.txt의 20행
// [필수 11] "dense_4_B.txt" (Shape 20)
parameter real dense_4_B[0:N_NEURONS-1] = {1.173028349876403809e-01, 8.045756071805953979e-02, 3.475685045123100281e-02,
-1.456189602613449097e-01, 4.271369427442550659e-02, 1.619396805763244629e-01, 2.553393244743347168e-01, -1.450603604316711426e-01,
-5.423777922987937927e-02, -1.133476123213768005e-01, -1.330076605081558228e-01, 2.971737980842590332e-01, 9.839988499879837036e-02,
-5.285954475402832031e-02, -6.325389444828033447e-02, -4.222545400261878967e-02, -7.815081626176834106e-02, -1.051729428581893444e-03,
3.977618739008903503e-02, 5.153045058250427246e-02};

// Layer 6: "output_y" (Input: 20, Output: 1, Linear)
real I_log_scaled_raw;
// [필수 12] "output_y_W.txt" (Shape 20, 1) -> 1D 1개로 변환
parameter real output_y_W[0:N_NEURONS-1] = {6.793328523635864258e-01, 5.306792259216308594e-01, 1.760172396898269653e-01,
1.669774651527404785e+00, 2.313196212053298950e-01, -1.291435241699218750e+00, 3.249200582504272461e-01, -1.977866411209106445e+00,
5.073203444480895996e-01, -4.301231354475021362e-02, -1.250401020050048828e+00, 9.819368124008178711e-01, 1.530087828636169434e+00,
-4.273601174354553223e-01, -1.475288122892379761e-01, -1.790317334234714508e-02, 4.878608584403991699e-01, 3.441732823848724365e-01,
-6.232312321662902832e-01, 1.541760712862014771e-01}; // <-- 20개 숫자를 1줄에 
// [필수 13] "output_y_B.txt" (Shape 1) -> 1D 1개로 변환
parameter real output_y_B = 5.794501677155494690e-02; // <-- 1개 숫자

// --- 루프 카운터 ---
integer h;

analog begin

    // --- 0. 초기화 및 시간 스텝 ---
    $bound_step(time_step);
    
    @(initial_step) begin
        if(analysis("tran")) begin
        W_internal = 0.0; 
        v_range = v_max - v_min;
        i_log_range = i_log_max - i_log_min;
	write_latched = 0;
        end
    end
    
    // --- 1. 입력 및 전처리 (Scaling) ---
    V_in = V(p, n);
    V_scaled = (V_in - v_min) / v_range;
    
    
    // --- 2. BLOCK 1: State Predictor (W_t+1 = f(V_t, W_t)) ---
    
    // Layer 1: "dense" (Input: [V_scaled, W_internal])
    for (h = 0; h < N_NEURONS; h = h + 1) begin
        // (V * W_v) + (W * W_w) + B
        h1_in[h] = (V_scaled * dense_W_V[h]) + (W_internal * dense_W_W[h]) + dense_B[h];
        
        // ReLU
        if (h1_in[h] < 0) h1_out[h] = 0.0;
        else h1_out[h] = h1_in[h];
    end
    
    // Layer 2: "dense_1" (Input: h1_out) -> 수동 Unroll
    for (h = 0; h < N_NEURONS; h = h + 1) begin
        h2_in[h] = 0.0;
        // Matrix Multiplication (Dot Product) - 수동으로 펼치기
        h2_in[h] = h2_in[h] + (h1_out[0] * dense_1_W_0[h]);
        h2_in[h] = h2_in[h] + (h1_out[1] * dense_1_W_1[h]);
        h2_in[h] = h2_in[h] + (h1_out[2] * dense_1_W_2[h]);
        h2_in[h] = h2_in[h] + (h1_out[3] * dense_1_W_3[h]);
        h2_in[h] = h2_in[h] + (h1_out[4] * dense_1_W_4[h]);
        h2_in[h] = h2_in[h] + (h1_out[5] * dense_1_W_5[h]);
        h2_in[h] = h2_in[h] + (h1_out[6] * dense_1_W_6[h]);
        h2_in[h] = h2_in[h] + (h1_out[7] * dense_1_W_7[h]);
        h2_in[h] = h2_in[h] + (h1_out[8] * dense_1_W_8[h]);
        h2_in[h] = h2_in[h] + (h1_out[9] * dense_1_W_9[h]);
        h2_in[h] = h2_in[h] + (h1_out[10] * dense_1_W_10[h]);
        h2_in[h] = h2_in[h] + (h1_out[11] * dense_1_W_11[h]);
        h2_in[h] = h2_in[h] + (h1_out[12] * dense_1_W_12[h]);
        h2_in[h] = h2_in[h] + (h1_out[13] * dense_1_W_13[h]);
        h2_in[h] = h2_in[h] + (h1_out[14] * dense_1_W_14[h]);
        h2_in[h] = h2_in[h] + (h1_out[15] * dense_1_W_15[h]);
        h2_in[h] = h2_in[h] + (h1_out[16] * dense_1_W_16[h]);
        h2_in[h] = h2_in[h] + (h1_out[17] * dense_1_W_17[h]);
        h2_in[h] = h2_in[h] + (h1_out[18] * dense_1_W_18[h]);
        h2_in[h] = h2_in[h] + (h1_out[19] * dense_1_W_19[h]);
        
        // Bias
        h2_in[h] = h2_in[h] + dense_1_B[h];
        
        // ReLU
        if (h2_in[h] < 0) h2_out[h] = 0.0;
        else h2_out[h] = h2_in[h];
    end
    
    // Layer 3: "output_w" (Input: h2_out) -> Softmax
    W_probs_sum_exp = 0.0; 
    for (h = 0; h < N_STATES; h = h + 1) begin
        W_probs_raw[h] = 0.0;
        // Matrix Multiplication (Dot Product) - 수동으로 펼치기
        W_probs_raw[h] = W_probs_raw[h] + (h2_out[0] * output_w_W_0[h]);
        W_probs_raw[h] = W_probs_raw[h] + (h2_out[1] * output_w_W_1[h]);
        W_probs_raw[h] = W_probs_raw[h] + (h2_out[2] * output_w_W_2[h]);
        W_probs_raw[h] = W_probs_raw[h] + (h2_out[3] * output_w_W_3[h]);
        W_probs_raw[h] = W_probs_raw[h] + (h2_out[4] * output_w_W_4[h]);
        W_probs_raw[h] = W_probs_raw[h] + (h2_out[5] * output_w_W_5[h]);
        W_probs_raw[h] = W_probs_raw[h] + (h2_out[6] * output_w_W_6[h]);
        W_probs_raw[h] = W_probs_raw[h] + (h2_out[7] * output_w_W_7[h]);
        W_probs_raw[h] = W_probs_raw[h] + (h2_out[8] * output_w_W_8[h]);
        W_probs_raw[h] = W_probs_raw[h] + (h2_out[9] * output_w_W_9[h]);
        W_probs_raw[h] = W_probs_raw[h] + (h2_out[10] * output_w_W_10[h]);
        W_probs_raw[h] = W_probs_raw[h] + (h2_out[11] * output_w_W_11[h]);
        W_probs_raw[h] = W_probs_raw[h] + (h2_out[12] * output_w_W_12[h]);
        W_probs_raw[h] = W_probs_raw[h] + (h2_out[13] * output_w_W_13[h]);
        W_probs_raw[h] = W_probs_raw[h] + (h2_out[14] * output_w_W_14[h]);
        W_probs_raw[h] = W_probs_raw[h] + (h2_out[15] * output_w_W_15[h]);
        W_probs_raw[h] = W_probs_raw[h] + (h2_out[16] * output_w_W_16[h]);
        W_probs_raw[h] = W_probs_raw[h] + (h2_out[17] * output_w_W_17[h]);
        W_probs_raw[h] = W_probs_raw[h] + (h2_out[18] * output_w_W_18[h]);
        W_probs_raw[h] = W_probs_raw[h] + (h2_out[19] * output_w_W_19[h]);
        
        // Bias
        W_probs_raw[h] = W_probs_raw[h] + output_w_B[h];
        
        // Softmax 1단계: exp(x)
        W_probs[h] = exp(W_probs_raw[h]); 
        W_probs_sum_exp = W_probs_sum_exp + W_probs[h];
    end
    
    // Softmax 2단계: exp(x) / sum(exp(x))
    for (h = 0; h < N_STATES; h = h + 1) begin
        W_probs[h] = W_probs[h] / (W_probs_sum_exp + 1e-20); 
    end

    
    // --- 3. BLOCK 2: Current Predictor (I_t = g(V_t, W_probs_t)) ---
    
    // Layer 4: "dense_3" (Input: [V_scaled, W_probs[0..3]])
    for (h = 0; h < N_NEURONS; h = h + 1) begin
        h3_in[h] = 0.0;
        h3_in[h] = h3_in[h] + (V_scaled * dense_3_W_V[h]);
        h3_in[h] = h3_in[h] + (W_probs[0] * dense_3_W_P0[h]);
        h3_in[h] = h3_in[h] + (W_probs[1] * dense_3_W_P1[h]);
        h3_in[h] = h3_in[h] + (W_probs[2] * dense_3_W_P2[h]);
        h3_in[h] = h3_in[h] + (W_probs[3] * dense_3_W_P3[h]);

        h3_in[h] = h3_in[h] + dense_3_B[h];
        
        // ReLU
        if (h3_in[h] < 0) h3_out[h] = 0.0;
        else h3_out[h] = h3_in[h];
    end
    
    // Layer 5: "dense_4" (Input: h3_out) -> 수동 Unroll
    for (h = 0; h < N_NEURONS; h = h + 1) begin
        h4_in[h] = 0.0;
        h4_in[h] = h4_in[h] + (h3_out[0] * dense_4_W_0[h]);
        h4_in[h] = h4_in[h] + (h3_out[1] * dense_4_W_1[h]);
        h4_in[h] = h4_in[h] + (h3_out[2] * dense_4_W_2[h]);
        h4_in[h] = h4_in[h] + (h3_out[3] * dense_4_W_3[h]);
        h4_in[h] = h4_in[h] + (h3_out[4] * dense_4_W_4[h]);
        h4_in[h] = h4_in[h] + (h3_out[5] * dense_4_W_5[h]);
        h4_in[h] = h4_in[h] + (h3_out[6] * dense_4_W_6[h]);
        h4_in[h] = h4_in[h] + (h3_out[7] * dense_4_W_7[h]);
        h4_in[h] = h4_in[h] + (h3_out[8] * dense_4_W_8[h]);
        h4_in[h] = h4_in[h] + (h3_out[9] * dense_4_W_9[h]);
        h4_in[h] = h4_in[h] + (h3_out[10] * dense_4_W_10[h]);
        h4_in[h] = h4_in[h] + (h3_out[11] * dense_4_W_11[h]);
        h4_in[h] = h4_in[h] + (h3_out[12] * dense_4_W_12[h]);
        h4_in[h] = h4_in[h] + (h3_out[13] * dense_4_W_13[h]);
        h4_in[h] = h4_in[h] + (h3_out[14] * dense_4_W_14[h]);
        h4_in[h] = h4_in[h] + (h3_out[15] * dense_4_W_15[h]);
        h4_in[h] = h4_in[h] + (h3_out[16] * dense_4_W_16[h]);
        h4_in[h] = h4_in[h] + (h3_out[17] * dense_4_W_17[h]);
        h4_in[h] = h4_in[h] + (h3_out[18] * dense_4_W_18[h]);
        h4_in[h] = h4_in[h] + (h3_out[19] * dense_4_W_19[h]);

        h4_in[h] = h4_in[h] + dense_4_B[h];
        
        // ReLU
        if (h4_in[h] < 0) h4_out[h] = 0.0;
        else h4_out[h] = h4_in[h];
    end

    // Layer 6: "output_y" (Input: h4_out) -> Linear (Dot Product)
    I_log_scaled_raw = 0.0;
    I_log_scaled_raw = I_log_scaled_raw + (h4_out[0] * output_y_W[0]);
    I_log_scaled_raw = I_log_scaled_raw + (h4_out[1] * output_y_W[1]);
    I_log_scaled_raw = I_log_scaled_raw + (h4_out[2] * output_y_W[2]);
    I_log_scaled_raw = I_log_scaled_raw + (h4_out[3] * output_y_W[3]);
    I_log_scaled_raw = I_log_scaled_raw + (h4_out[4] * output_y_W[4]);
    I_log_scaled_raw = I_log_scaled_raw + (h4_out[5] * output_y_W[5]);
    I_log_scaled_raw = I_log_scaled_raw + (h4_out[6] * output_y_W[6]);
    I_log_scaled_raw = I_log_scaled_raw + (h4_out[7] * output_y_W[7]);
    I_log_scaled_raw = I_log_scaled_raw + (h4_out[8] * output_y_W[8]);
    I_log_scaled_raw = I_log_scaled_raw + (h4_out[9] * output_y_W[9]);
    I_log_scaled_raw = I_log_scaled_raw + (h4_out[10] * output_y_W[10]);
    I_log_scaled_raw = I_log_scaled_raw + (h4_out[11] * output_y_W[11]);
    I_log_scaled_raw = I_log_scaled_raw + (h4_out[12] * output_y_W[12]);
    I_log_scaled_raw = I_log_scaled_raw + (h4_out[13] * output_y_W[13]);
    I_log_scaled_raw = I_log_scaled_raw + (h4_out[14] * output_y_W[14]);
    I_log_scaled_raw = I_log_scaled_raw + (h4_out[15] * output_y_W[15]);
    I_log_scaled_raw = I_log_scaled_raw + (h4_out[16] * output_y_W[16]);
    I_log_scaled_raw = I_log_scaled_raw + (h4_out[17] * output_y_W[17]);
    I_log_scaled_raw = I_log_scaled_raw + (h4_out[18] * output_y_W[18]);
    I_log_scaled_raw = I_log_scaled_raw + (h4_out[19] * output_y_W[19]);	
    
    I_log_scaled = I_log_scaled_raw + output_y_B;
    
   
    if (I_log_scaled > 1.0) I_log_scaled = 1.0;
    else if (I_log_scaled < 0.0) I_log_scaled = 0.0;
    // --- 4. 전류(I) 출력 후처리 (Un-scaling & Un-logging) ---
    I_out = (I_log_scaled * i_log_range) + i_log_min;
    
    if (V_in >= 0)
        I_out = pow(10, I_out);
    else
        I_out = (-1) * pow(10, I_out);
            
//    real I_lim = 0.02;
  //  I_out = I_out / (1.0 + abs(I_out) / I_lim);
//
  //  real tau = 1e-9;
    //I_out = transition(I_out, I_out, tau, tau);
            
    // --- 5. 다음 스텝을 위한 '내부 상태(W)' 업데이트 (Argmax) ---
    max_prob = W_probs[0];
    new_state = 0.0;
    
    if (W_probs[1] > max_prob) begin
        max_prob = W_probs[1];
        new_state = 1.0;
    end
    if (W_probs[2] > max_prob) begin
        max_prob = W_probs[2];
        new_state = 2.0;
    end
    if (W_probs[3] > max_prob) begin
        max_prob = W_probs[3];
        new_state = 3.0;
    end
    
    if ( (V_in >= vth_write_pos) || (V_in <= vth_write_neg) ) begin
	//if(write_latched == 0) begin
		W_internal = new_state;
	//	write_latched = 1;
	//end
    end
    //else begin
//	write_latched = 0;
  //  end

    // W_internal = new_state;
    
    
    // --- 6. 최종 전류(I) 출력 ---
    I(p, n) <+ I_out;
    
end
endmodule
